metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Fugue X in E minor, three voices: Fuga a due cori con corale
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam (chorale: Nikolaus Decius, "O Lamm Gottes, unschuldig"; after J. S. Bach, BWV 244 no. 1)
metadata.instrument: Keyboard, three voices (two choirs and a chorale)

markers.label: Exposition: Coro I subject, Coro II inversion

subject_entries.label: Coro II: inversion (answer, from the dominant)
Coro I: subject under chorale line 1 (tail in natural minor, against the chorale D)
Coro II: inversion (E minor) under chorale line 2
Recognition: Coro I, subject in G major = the chorale line in diminution
Recognition: Coro II, subject in E minor a tenth below (natural-minor tail)
Recognition: Coro I, inversion in G major
Recognition: Coro II, inversion in B minor a sixth below (A natural against the chorale D)
Coro II: subject in augmentation (E minor) under chorale line 4
Coro I: inversion (G major), a beat before chorale line 5 (stretto 1)
Coro II: subject (E minor), two beats later (stretto 2)
Coro I: subject on B (diatonic in G major) under chorale line 6, a tenth above Coro II
Coro II: subject (G major) a tenth below
Final stretto: Coro II, inversion (E minor) under the last chorale line (second half re-voiced to fill the thirds; tail turned down to the dominant)
Final stretto: Coro I, subject (E minor; neighbour D natural against the chorale's D), two beats later: the final cadence
